planets.name: LP 890-9 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of LP 890-9 with a 2.73-day year, found in 2022.

text.card: LP 890-9 b was found in 2022 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around LP 890-9. Its orbit and size follow Delrez et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
